title: Blanchard: "Boy, did we screw up"
place_text: Roswell Army Air Field, New Mexico

tellings.quote: And all Blanchard would do was laugh and said, "Boy, did we screw up?"

plain: Colonel Blanchard, the commander at Roswell Army Air Field in New Mexico, the base at the centre of the 1947 claim that a crashed flying saucer was recovered, is said to have laughed later about the affair and said, "Boy, did we screw up." The physicist John Brandenburg tells this in 2025, passing on what he says came from Blanchard and from Roswell veterans. To him it suggests that the base's handling of the event, not the event itself, was the mistake.
